level1.title: Jesus Touches a Sick Man
level1.story: A man with leprosy knelt before Jesus. He said, "If You want to, You can make me clean." Jesus touched him and said, "I will. Be clean!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus do for the man?
Who can you help who feels left out?
actions: Be kind to someone left out

activity.title: Jesus' healing hand
activity.intro: Jesus reached out His hand. Trace yours and write a prayer on each finger.

level2.title: Healing the Leper
level2.story: A leper came to Jesus, knelt down, and begged, "If Thou wilt, Thou canst make me clean." Moved with compassion, Jesus stretched out His hand and touched him. Jesus said, "I will. Be thou made clean," and the leprosy left him at once. Jesus told him to tell no one but to show himself to the priest. But the man went out and told everyone, so that people came to Jesus from every side.
level2.keyLine: I will. Be thou made clean.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why was touching a leper so surprising?
level2.prayer: Jesus, make me clean and make me kind. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus, I wonder...
activity.intro: Jesus touched the leper. Write what you wonder.
starters: Jesus, I wonder how the man felt...
I wonder why You touched him...

art.mainBrief: Jesus touching a man with leprosy gently
